summary: Focana 2.4.10 makes compact, full, and floating transitions steadier across changing window sizes.
improvements: Compact, full, and floating views now hold their task and timer layout more reliably through repeated resizing and theme changes.
fixes: Full focus view can no longer be resized shorter than its active content, preventing the task card and controls from being clipped.
Background window transitions no longer let the floating timer take focus when it first appears.
